notes: Department lists sourced from each state's official portal: Karnataka from mahitikanaja.karnataka.gov.in/Department (35 core departments; a further 7 departments confirmed only via minister-portfolio notes in the existing states-ka-ap-tg.json are marked confidence:low and flagged with that source); Andhra Pradesh from the GO Information Retrieval system's department dropdown at goir.ap.gov.in (29 departments); Telangana from the official 'Departments' menu at telangana.gov.in/departments (41 departments). headPositionId assignments follow the portfolio notes already recorded on each minister in data/raw/states-ka-ap-tg.json; a few departments (e.g. Water Resources/irrigation sub-charges, Women & Child Welfare in Karnataka, Law in KA/TG, School Education and Home in Telangana) could not be confidently pinned to one minister from the existing notes and are left with headPositionId omitted rather than guessed. Administrative-secretary research was constrained: this session's shared WebSearch budget (200 calls) was already exhausted by sibling research agents before this segment ran, and Karnataka/Andhra Pradesh department sites (finance.karnataka.gov.in, home.karnataka.gov.in, *.ap.gov.in subdomains) are JS-rendered single-page apps that returned no server-rendered officer names via curl/WebFetch. Only Telangana's four secretary positions above are included, sourced directly from each department's own official page, which are the only ones this pass could verify to the 2025-2026 currency bar in SCHEMA.md; all other secretary positions are omitted rather than guessed, per SCHEMA.md guidance.
